bodyparts3d.modifications: Selected reference OBJ meshes converted to GLB triangles and float32 coordinates in metres (source millimetres); source vertices retained, with a single rigid root rotation from documented source Z-up to glTF Y-up; no smoothing or generated anatomy.
bodyparts3d.historicalNotice: The official archive relicensed the database to CC BY 4.0 on 2025-02-27. OBJ comments retain the historical CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan notice; the pinned updated archive licence and README explicitly cover redistribution and derivatives of release 4.0.

uberon.modifications: Reviewed renal subset plus asserted ancestors; only explicit is_a and part_of edges. No logical inference or FMA identifier rewriting.
uberon.scope: Uberon is a multispecies ontology. This selected reference subset is not a human clinical model.
